description: This file defines the DuplexPipe class which implements the IDuplexPipe interface, facilitating paired input/output pipe communication, along with a factory method to create connection pairs. It also includes a nested struct DuplexPipePair for managing the duplex pipe pairs.

classes.name: DuplexPipe
classes.description: A class implementing IDuplexPipe to wrap PipeReader and PipeWriter for duplex communication, including a method to create paired connections.

methods.name: DuplexPipe
methods.description: Constructor initializing DuplexPipe with given PipeReader and PipeWriter.

methods.name: CreateConnectionPair
methods.description: Static method to create a pair of interconnected DuplexPipe instances with specified pipe options.

methods.name: DuplexPipe.DuplexPipePair
methods.description: A readonly struct holding a pair of IDuplexPipe instances for transport and application layers.
